posts.bodyHtml:
♥ Hello Dream Community ♥

0) Do I meet the requirements?
Yes I do meet the requirements to become one of the most important roles for Dream Community as a Test-Admin at the Knife server, I have become a lot more active and have improved my maturity and behaviour a lot over the last couple of months, I have been taught by Doo Doo and Nachtfrische they have helped me a lot and gave me key points of following and showing better to other that people can improve and everyone deserves the chance, I have spoke to sky about my application points and he said that they will be removed so I'm posting within the community rules.
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My Real name is Michal and ingame it's Oxygen.
2) How old are you?
I'm 16 years of age.
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
I want to join the Dream Community administrative team for many reasons first of all is all the rule breakers which are Delays which keep the fun away from people so it kinda gets boring and annoying, second of all is the mic abusers we all were at that moment when someone mic abused but there were no available admins so that is the other reason, thirdly is the hackers I know they don't get on the server very often but it is possible for one to attend and ruin the entire fun for everyone with bhop scripts or auto knife so he will always get a perfect hit, reason four is all the 2v1's and above everyone was at that moment when they got stacked on unfair because there is no available admins, I will be able to stop most of these so there is fun and peace on dream community without admin power abusing now.
4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
On the dream server I have been playing now for 7800 minutes which is 130 hours so the community got to know me well.
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
My favourite hobbies are going mountain biking through the rough terrain as it gives you a little thrill and excitement, I also like to spend my time well with friends and family which are number one for me also If I don't do any of these above I love to spend my time on Dream Community Knife server which I really got hold of and made good friends and supporters.
6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
Yes I do think of myself as mature because I have received over time a lot of support from Doo Doo and my close family and I have put a lot of effort into being mature, I also don't argue with people which I used to do a lot if there is a problem on the Dream Server as a player is breaking a rule I warn them that they are rule breaking if they carry on or get anymore abusive I just message one of the admins which are available to sort out the problem without much of spamming them as they have their own stuff to do so not every time they will be able to help but for sure if I record evidence and post it on forum I will get in touch by one.
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
I did gain administrator experience as most people know I was a test admin before but I did failed and I learned from my mistakes and I have took into consideration what have I done wrong and sure it will not happen again.
[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)



Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 13-22 13-23 13-22:30 14-23:30 14-01:30 13-02:30 13-22


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
If I know they were friends I would allow it but not to excessive amount, I would warn user 1 of his/her behaviour if they carried on I would just mute him till the end of the current map that was played if he carries on I would have to kick him for a abusive language and if he comes back and insults me or carries on to insult user 2 I would have to ban him for at least 30 minutes I would also take to consideration if he had bans before for the same reason but If I was not on the server and I got called in I would mute user 1 and interview the user 2 which later then I would mute user 2 and unmute user 1 and interview him at the end I would ask the community for their experience and what happened on the server if user 1 & 2 were abusive at that moment which then I would make the most reasonable decision of possible banning one of them.
10) Strengths
- Maturity which has drastically improved over the course of time.
- Attention to details which has improved a lot too.
- Understanding of players
- Easily approached
- Respectful
- I listen to everyone's word and what they got to say to me
11) Weaknesses
- Sometimes players don't understand me as I speak rather too fast and English is not my first language but I got it to level where I'm understandable but I can speak too fast.
- I do make mistakes like everyone I'm not perfect
12) Conclusion / Closing remark
Thank you for reading my application hope it gives you a good impression of me and how I changed into better without the support I received from Doo Doo and person close to my life I would not change and I would not apply now as I would surely abuse or be nasty to anyone but I want to prove them wrong, I promise from bottom of my heart I will not admin abuse as I learned from my mistake and took into consideration key points from Doo Doo and Nachtfrische, hope you like my application and I'm looking to see you in game.



♥Peace ♥

Well well well, hello there again Oxygen. Very nice to see that you are still eager to help out the Dream admin team.


What can I say, you've had many up and downs with your time with us and I hope that this will turn out to be one of those 'up' moments for you. We've had quite a few talks regarding your behavior and you kept trying to convince us that you WILL change and that you WILL be a better person.


Here is a general pro's and con's list:
[like*] You have written yet another splendid application (which had little to none spelling/grammar/punctuation mistakes which tells me that you have brushed up on your attention to detail.
[like*] You have been quite promising in the way that you tell us and ensure us that you will no longer make silly mistakes or have an inappropriate attitude.
[like*] You are relatively active whether it be on the knife server or online on steam which shows us that you are available most of the time.
[like*] You seem to be a more open person that people will find welcoming and easy to talk to.
[like*] You are now of an age where you are in line with the general age requirement to fill the admin position.
[like*] This aura of you changing seems realistic and I do see slight signs of improvements.


However:
[disli-ke*] You do seem quite strict sometimes when playing on the server - "Your job is to maintain order and let players have fun, not to piss them off" - A wise man once said (@Nachtfrische)
[disli-ke*] On answer 6, you say how you "don't argue with people" and "I just message one of the admins which are available to sort out the problem" - I don't believe that this is the idea solution as the point of you joining our administrative team is so that you are trusted with the powers to make decisions for yourself and not rely on other admins and so that you can maintain the servers when admins are absent.
[disli-ke*] You still seem to lack a lot of patience and show us this sense of immaturity like a kid wanting candy or so. Your points were removed today and you asked me if you should post your application now even though I advised you to wait a bit until we all see the change of attitude in you but you simply disregarded this fact.
[disli-ke*] You seem very reliant on me and @Nachtfrische but however, as an admin, you will mostly need to be independent, are you able to work alone? Are you able to handle situations effectively by yourself? Are you able to reflect on your actions without relying on another person to tell you what you've done wrong?
[disli-ke*] You are (more or less) on your last final warning, the last warning that actually, you have created yourself. You PROMISED us that you will not do wrong again and if you do, we may permanently remove you from the Dream community so the space for mistakes is very tight for you.
[disli-ke*] You seem to take decisions very fast and hastily without thinking, for example, the time where you mentioned how it was 'the end of my journey' and then a few days later, claimed how you want to stay in Dream for a long time.



That's it for my analysis of you and my thoughts and opinion on you so far.


However, I have a very important question for you. As a Dream admin, you are required to be very loyal and faithful towards the Dream community and the Dream community alone.


Say, if I was to leave the admin team to whatever reason and I was to leave Dream and go to this new, awesome community and offered you a higher rank in this community if you were to leave Dream. Honestly, how would you reply?


My vote remains neutral.


Thank you for your time,
~Doo Doo

@Doo Doo Thank your for your response to my application.
Regarding your questions I will answer them below.


Are you able to work alone?
Yes I'm more than 100% able to work on my own with 100% positive attitude and with good intentions.
Are you able to handle situations effectively by yourself?
Yes I will be able to handle situations on my own without support from a higher admin as that's my main goal to support everyone and handle situations which are highly stressful.
Are you able to reflect on your actions without relying on another person to tell you what you've done wrong?
Yes I'm able to do that and I'm sure I will do it good without any problems from my site and every action I will take now will be strongly thought about and reasoned well before.
Say, if I was to leave the admin team to whatever reason and I was to leave Dream and go to this new, awesome community and offered you a higher rank in this community if you were to leave Dream. Honestly, how would you reply?
I would not accept the offer as this will show that you're not loyal for the community and it will destroy your personality and will affect how people look at you, for me doing something like this it's a no no and I would not do this towards Dream even if I was to be bribed to go.
